pages.title: Electric Mining Rig
pages.text: An upgraded mining rig that requires power but can mine more vein types.$(br2)Power Draw: 5 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 item per 3 seconds$(br)Mines: wider range of vein types

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: The Electric Mining Rig must be within a pylon's supply range. Output is automatically sent to the $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/global_storage)Global Storage$().$(br2)If power is insufficient, the rig pauses and resumes when power is restored.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
